summary: Digimarc Corp. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under an existing shelf registration (S-3) to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $17.5 million of common stock through agent Needham & Company. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No activist, M&A, restructuring, or other special event is present. The company will pay a 3% commission on sales. The last reported price was $13.63/share. There is no tender, spin-off, or other corporate event.
